articles.headline: Rubio kicks off India visit amid trade and oil talks
articles.brief: US officials visit India to negotiate an ongoing trade agreement and discuss regional energy policies, including the complex matter of Russian oil imports.

articles.headline: Chinese tech giants order over $35B in Nvidia chips
articles.brief: Major technology firms including ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent have placed massive orders exceeding $35 billion for advanced Nvidia artificial intelligence processors.

articles.headline: Brent oil hits five-month high on supply worries
articles.brief: Global crude prices surged to a five-month peak as continuous attacks on commercial shipping lanes and energy facilities fueled severe supply disruption concerns.

articles.headline: Google Cloud and Revolut face major London outage
articles.brief: Google Cloud services experienced unexpected disruptions across London, causing downtime for various integrated platform users, including financial technology service Revolut.

articles.headline: AstraZeneca and Oracle partner for AI clinical trials
articles.brief: Pharmaceutical giant AstraZeneca has announced a strategic partnership with Oracle to integrate advanced artificial intelligence capabilities into its global clinical trial processes.

articles.headline: Death toll rises in Houthi strike on Yemen camp
articles.brief: The confirmed death toll following a ballistic missile strike by Iran-backed Houthi rebels on a military training camp in Yemen's Shabwa province has climbed to 60.

articles.headline: India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement goes live
articles.brief: A historic bilateral free trade agreement between India and New Zealand has officially come into effect, promising lower tariffs and enhanced economic cooperation.

articles.headline: Ousted Bangladesh PM Hasina plans December return
articles.brief: Exiled former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has stated her intention to return to Bangladesh in December, acknowledging severe personal security risks upon her arrival.

articles.headline: Modern warfare targets data centers and cloud servers
articles.brief: Recent military conflicts highlighting infrastructure attacks on digital servers and cloud repositories underscore the growing vulnerability of vital artificial intelligence networks.

articles.headline: Delhi to ban non-BS VI vehicles to curb pollution
articles.brief: Authorities in Delhi are implementing strict new anti-pollution measures, including a complete ban on non-BS VI compliant vehicles starting November 1 ahead of winter.

articles.headline: India dominates latest ICC Women's T20I bowling rankings
articles.brief: Indian bowlers Shree Charani and Deepti Sharma have claimed top positions in the recent ICC Women's T20I bowling rankings following strong team performances.

articles.headline: Vietnam explores remote work to combat severe smog
articles.brief: Vietnam has proposed emergency remote work protocols and online schooling options for government employees and students as worsening air quality reaches critical levels.

articles.headline: CBDT mandates Form 173A for foreign investor tax perks
articles.brief: The Central Board of Direct Taxes has introduced a mandatory filing requirement via Form 173A for foreign entities claiming tax exemptions on government securities.

articles.headline: SCO meet: Rajnath Singh calls for dismantling terrorism
articles.brief: At a regional Shanghai Cooperation Organisation meeting, India's defense leadership stressed the urgent need to collectively dismantle international terrorist networks.

articles.headline: Alberta rejects separation bid in political win for Carney
articles.brief: Political stability received a boost in Canada as the province of Alberta officially rejected a proposed separation bid, marking a significant win for national unity.
